applications.waiveCooldownReasonHint: Kept in the audit log. Do not write personal data.
applications.cooldownWaived: Waiting period lifted on {date}: this application no longer stops the candidate from applying again.

stories.title: Success stories
stories.intro: Stories shown on the home page. Drag to change their order. A story needs a signed consent document to be published.
stories.showFullName: Show the full last name (needs the candidate's consent); otherwise only its first letter
stories.created: The story is created as a draft.
stories.published: The story is on the site.
stories.unpublished: The story is no longer on the site.
stories.deleteText: The story of {name}, its photo and its consent document are deleted.

slides.title: Home slides
slides.intro: The large slider at the top of the home page. Drag to change the order.
slides.empty: No slide: the site shows its three default slides.
slides.subtitle: Subtitle
slides.ctaUrlHint: A page of the site, such as /jobs?destination=MALTA, or an https address.
slides.deleteText: “{title}” is removed from the home page.
slides.previewHint: The real slider, at half size, with the slides shown. The site follows as soon as you save.

catalog.title: Destinations and categories
catalog.intro: The lists used by jobs, filters and alerts.
catalog.codeHint: Upper-case letters, for example MALTA. It cannot be changed later.
catalog.slugHint: Lower-case letters and hyphens, for example hospitality. It cannot be changed later.
catalog.iconHint: An emoji or an icon name. Optional.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.jobCount: {count, plural, =0 {No job} one {# job} other {# jobs}}
catalog.deleteText: “{name}” is deleted if nothing uses it; otherwise it is switched off and its jobs stay.
catalog.deactivated: Still used by jobs: switched off instead of deleted.

users.title: Users and roles
users.intro: Accounts of the team. Only a super admin sees this page.
users.inviteText: The person receives an email with a link to choose a password. The link works 72 hours.

roleHelp.VIEWER: Viewer: reads jobs, applications, candidates and messages. Cannot change anything, export, or see full passport numbers.
roleHelp.RECRUITER: Recruiter: manages jobs, applications and site content, exports, and can show a passport number (logged).
roleHelp.SUPER_ADMIN: Super admin: everything, plus users, settings and the audit log.

users.roleText: {email} becomes {role}. The new rights apply at once, without logging in again.
users.disableText: {email} is logged out at once and cannot log in any more.
users.deleteText: {email} is logged out and can never log in again. What this person did stays in the audit log. This cannot be undone.
users.logoutText: Every session of {email} ends at once. The person can log in again.

messages.title: Contact messages
messages.intro: {count, plural, =0 {No message to handle.} one {# message to handle.} other {# messages to handle.}}
messages.search: Search a name, an email or a subject
messages.reopened: Put back among the messages to handle.
messages.deleteText: The message of {name} is removed for good. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Rules of the platform and details shown on the site. Each change is written to the audit log.

groupHelp.rules: Applied by the API at once.
groupHelp.contact: Shown in the top bar, the footer and the contact page.
groupHelp.social: Links shown in the footer. Leave a field empty to hide the link.
groupHelp.deletion: A super admin can always delete candidates and applications.

keys.ALLOW_RECRUITER_DELETE: Recruiters may delete candidates and applications

help.REAPPLY_COOLDOWN_MONTHS: 0 to 60. A candidate must wait this long before applying to the same job again.
help.CONTACT_EMAIL: Also receives the messages of the contact form.
help.CONTACT_WHATSAPP: With the country code; opens a WhatsApp chat.
help.ALLOW_RECRUITER_DELETE: Off: only a super admin can. Each deletion needs a reason and is written to the audit log.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change made in the back office, newest first. Nothing here can be edited.

deletion.willRemove: This will be removed for good:
deletion.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log with your name. Do not write names, addresses or other personal data here.

history.title: Historical results
history.intro: Results IconBridge obtained before this platform existed. They are kept apart from the applications and added to them in the dashboard totals and in the counters of the home page.
history.globalIntro: One figure for all years and destinations.

help.PARTNER_COMPANIES: Added to the employers of the jobs published on the platform.
help.COUNTRIES_SERVED: The total number of countries. The site shows it when it is larger than the number of active destinations; the two are not added.

history.audited: Every change is written to the audit log with the value before and after.
history.saved: {count, plural, one {# figure saved} other {# figures saved}}. The counters of the site are updated.
